trigger.purpose: convert new account-recovery BP to the active Evidence ledger template

rationale: Convert the new account-recovery BP from the obsolete "Refs to set in scratchpad" heading to the active Evidence ledger template. Domain gates, outcomes, dependencies, and refs semantics are unchanged; the local evidence roles are now explicit so shared refs can remain generic.

dependencies.why: Customer-only account recovery rule, /bin/id account-match gate, and account-recovery incident pattern.
Defines the account-recovery-<customer_id>.json control-file naming this BP re-reads for post-state confirmation.
Tool signature send-email-link <customer_id> <destination_email> and the policy-not-enforced disclaimer; send-email-link is the only supported verb.
/bin/id output drives the customer-actor and ownership gate.
customer_id ownership link to /bin/id and customer_email private contact field.

rollback.strategy: Retire this version to fall back to v0001 if the template-only rewrite weakens account-recovery evidence handling.
